config.prompt: Perform only the demo-video readiness procedure. Do not access or change the target application. Use the demo-video skill: call the granted demo-narration.synthesize connector with text 'Narration is ready.', copy its WAV artifact to this workspace, run capture.mjs preflightCapture on an empty local page, then worker.py preflight with that --audio and --recording. Only after all checks pass write the readiness receipt with --receipt /artifacts/demo-video/preflight/${{explain-feedback.feedback.thread_id}}-${{explain-feedback.feedback.comment_id}}.txt --request-key ${{explain-feedback.feedback.repo}}:${{explain-feedback.feedback.pr_id}}:${{explain-feedback.feedback.thread_id}}:${{explain-feedback.feedback.comment_id}}:${{explain-builds.builds.0.run_id}}. The toolchain is /home/agent/.evander/demo-video/current. Preserve existing approval rules. If a grant, approval, narration config or tool is unavailable, report the issue and leave no readiness receipt. Deployment has not started.
